Luthier Hub.

Understand your circuit.
Make informed choices.
Build with confidence.

Technical clarity without mythology. Learn how passive guitar electronics behave, explore the trade-offs and translate that understanding into a reliable build.

Begin with a component or a question. Each guide connects to the next useful reference, an appropriate tool and the specifications to check at the bench.

Start with potentiometers

Six subjects. One connected library.

  1. 01

    Potentiometers

    Resistance, taper and physical fit. Understand how a control loads a pickup before choosing its specification.

  2. 02

    Capacitors & Tone Controls

    Follow the frequency-dependent loading branch, compare capacitor values and separate electrical specification from material folklore.

  3. 03

    Treble Bleeds

    Capacitor-only and resistor-capacitor networks, understood in the context of the volume control and its surrounding load.

  4. 04

    Wiring & Circuits

    Terminal identities, signal routes, grounding and practical assembly. Translate a circuit into connections you can inspect.

  5. 05

    Pickups & Switching

    Coil functions, conductor conventions and selector contacts. Identify the actual part instead of assuming that wire colour defines its job.

  6. 06

    Troubleshooting

    A methodical route from symptom to connection check, with useful definitions and clear limits on what a diagram can tell you.
